description: R-PAR-1 PAR-FOLD, SQL-AGG-FIRST, SQL-AGG-SINGLE: With Nulls mixed into Double groups (FN: g1 [Null, 9007199254740992, Null, 1, Null, -9007199254740992]; g2 [1, Null, Null, Null]; g3 [Null, Null]; g4 [Null, 5, Null, 7, Null]; g5 [2.5]), what do Count(*), Count(d), Sum, Avg, Min, Max, Var, VarP, StDev and StDevP give per group, overall, and through a derived table ordered by id DESC? Runs on a fresh copy of r-par-1-fold2 opened read-only through DAO OpenDatabase in one process and one STA; each statement is opened with Database.OpenRecordset as a snapshot unless stated, and every call's result, HRESULT and DBEngine.Errors are captured.
retentionNote: Designed r-par-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.

question.description: R-PAR-1 PAR-FOLD, SQL-AGG-FIRST, SQL-AGG-SINGLE: With Nulls mixed into Double groups (FN: g1 [Null, 9007199254740992, Null, 1, Null, -9007199254740992]; g2 [1, Null, Null, Null]; g3 [Null, Null]; g4 [Null, 5, Null, 7, Null]; g5 [2.5]), what do Count(*), Count(d), Sum, Avg, Min, Max, Var, VarP, StDev and StDevP give per group, overall, and through a derived table ordered by id DESC? Runs on a fresh copy of r-par-1-fold2 opened read-only through DAO OpenDatabase in one process and one STA; each statement is opened with Database.OpenRecordset as a snapshot unless stated, and every call's result, HRESULT and DBEngine.Errors are captured.

args.text: SELECT g, Count(*) AS c, Count(d) AS cd, Sum(d) AS s, Avg(d) AS a, Min(d) AS mn, Max(d) AS mx FROM FN GROUP BY g
SELECT g, Var(d) AS v, VarP(d) AS vp, StDev(d) AS sd, StDevP(d) AS sdp FROM FN GROUP BY g
SELECT Count(*) AS c, Count(d) AS cd, Sum(d) AS s, Avg(d) AS a, Min(d) AS mn, Max(d) AS mx FROM FN
SELECT Var(d) AS v, VarP(d) AS vp, StDev(d) AS sd, StDevP(d) AS sdp FROM FN
SELECT g, Sum(d) AS s, Avg(d) AS a FROM (SELECT g, d FROM FN ORDER BY id DESC) GROUP BY g
SELECT g, Var(d) AS v, StDev(d) AS sd FROM (SELECT g, d FROM FN ORDER BY id DESC) GROUP BY g
SELECT g, Sum(d) AS s FROM FN WHERE d Is Not Null GROUP BY g
